1 calculate B cell subsets

BCells: Cluster out BCells.1-16, cluster on the panel below B Cells Object Panel: CD20 CD19 PAX5 HLA DR CD38 IGD KI67 CXCR5 CD21 CD11C

gc()
##              used    (Mb) gc trigger    (Mb)   max used    (Mb)
## Ncells   20995004  1121.3   33535158  1791.0   21279930  1136.5
## Vcells 5458297131 41643.6 8017972434 61172.3 7741215068 59060.8
md <- pDataDT(sln); keepCells <- md$cell_ID[grep(pattern = "BCells", md$L2_annotations)]
Bcells <- subsetGiotto(sln, cell_ids = keepCells )
## Warning: Some of Giotto's expected python module(s) were not found:
## pandas, igraph, leidenalg, community, networkx, sklearn
## (This is fine if python-based functions are not needed)
## 
## ** Python path used:
## "/gpfs/home/heratr01/.local/share/r-miniconda/envs/r-reticulate/bin/python"
print("subcluster Bcells")
## [1] "subcluster Bcells"
clusterChannels <- c("CD19", "CD20", "PAX5", "HLA.DR", "CD38", "IGD", "KI67", "CXCR5", "CD21", "CD11C")
Bcells <- runPCA(gobject = Bcells, expression_values = "normalized", scale_unit = TRUE, 
              method = "factominer", feats_to_use = clusterChannels)
## a custom vector of genes will be used to subset the matrix
## Warning in .run_pca_factominer(x = t_flex(expr_values), scale = scale_unit, :
## ncp > ncol(x), will be set to ncol(x)
## > pca already exists and will be replaced with
##  new dimension reduction object
## Setting dimension reduction [cell][rna] pca
signPCA(Bcells, scale_unit = TRUE, scree_ylim = c(0,40))

Bcells <- createNearestNetwork(gobject = Bcells, dim_reduction_to_use = 'harmony', dim_reduction_name = 'harmony',

##  new nearest neighbor network
Bcells <- doLeidenClusterIgraph(gobject = Bcells, resolution = 0.1, n_iterations = 200, set_seed = T, seed_number = 43,
                                network_name = 'NN.harmony', name = 'leiden_Bcells.res0.1')  # make the clusters
Bcells <- doLeidenClusterIgraph(gobject = Bcells, resolution = 0.3, n_iterations = 200, set_seed = T, seed_number = 43,
                                network_name = 'NN.harmony', name = 'leiden_Bcells.res0.3')  # make the clusters
Bcells <- doLeidenClusterIgraph(gobject = Bcells, resolution = 0.5, n_iterations = 200, set_seed = T, seed_number = 43,
                                network_name = 'NN.harmony', name = 'leiden_Bcells.res0.5')  # make the clusters
Bcells <- doLeidenClusterIgraph(gobject = Bcells, resolution = 0.7, n_iterations = 200, set_seed = T, seed_number = 43,
                                network_name = 'NN.harmony', name = 'leiden_Bcells.res0.7')  # make the clusters
Bcells <- runUMAPprojection(Bcells, random_subset = 1e5, n_threads = parallelly::availableCores(), 
                                name="umap.Bcells")  # project UMAP coordinates to the full dataset based on a subsampling

saveRDS(md, paste0("md.",filename))
saveRDS(Giotto::getExpression(Bcells, values = "scaled", output = c("matrix"),  set_defaults = TRUE ),
